# Install the workshop kit

**English** · [Português](pt/INSTALL.md) · [हिन्दी](hi/INSTALL.md) · [עברית](he/INSTALL.md)

Do this **before** the workshop. It takes 10 to 20 minutes. You don't need admin rights.

## 1. Before you start

- Create an account on the [Anthropic Console](https://platform.claude.com) and add credits in Billing. We recommend a spend limit well above US$ 10: the workshop costs about US$ 5.
- **Mac:** open Terminal and run `xcode-select --install`. Click "Install" and wait until it finishes (5 to 15 minutes). If it says it is already installed, great.
- **Windows:** nothing to prepare. Use PowerShell (preferably in Windows Terminal).
- If you are on a company network with a proxy, the setup detects it. If something fails on the network, try your phone's hotspot.

## 2. Run the setup

**macOS** (Terminal):

```bash
curl -fsSL https://github.com/cx-guilherme-pinto/workshop-claude/releases/download/v1.1.0-rc.4/setup-mac.sh | bash
```

Alternative: `bash <(curl -fsSL https://github.com/cx-guilherme-pinto/workshop-claude/releases/download/v1.1.0-rc.4/setup-mac.sh)`

**Windows** (PowerShell):

```powershell
irm https://github.com/cx-guilherme-pinto/workshop-claude/releases/download/v1.1.0-rc.4/bootstrap-windows.ps1 | iex
```

Use Windows PowerShell, not PowerShell ISE. Behind a company proxy that answers `(407) Proxy Authentication Required`, use this one instead (it sends your Windows login to the proxy):

```powershell
[Net.WebRequest]::DefaultWebProxy.Credentials = [Net.CredentialCache]::DefaultNetworkCredentials; irm https://github.com/cx-guilherme-pinto/workshop-claude/releases/download/v1.1.0-rc.4/bootstrap-windows.ps1 | iex
```

If PowerShell blocks the command above, download [setup-windows.ps1](https://github.com/cx-guilherme-pinto/workshop-claude/releases/download/v1.1.0-rc.4/setup-windows.ps1) and run, in the folder where you saved it:

```powershell
Unblock-File .\setup-windows.ps1; powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\setup-windows.ps1
```

The setup speaks English on every machine. It asks a few questions (for example, the Console login, which opens the browser). It shows one line per step, with a spinner while the step runs, and a summary at the end. Each step ends with one of four states: ✔ Done · ✔ Already done · ▲ Done with warning · ✖ Failed (in the old Windows console window: [OK] · [OK] · [!!] · [XX]). When something fails, the setup tells you why and what to do, with the exact command.

The setup also detects the machine language. If you don't have Claude Code's `language` setting yet, it writes it (Portuguese, English, Hindi or Hebrew). The skills are written in English but answer in your language. The Arena, the orchestrator and the statusline are in Portuguese on a Portuguese machine and in English on all others.

## 3. Confirm

At the end you see "Everything is ready for the workshop." or the list of what is missing. To check again, without installing anything:

- macOS: `bash ~/.workshop-claude/setup-mac.sh --check`
- Windows: `powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$env:USERPROFILE\.workshop-claude\setup-windows.ps1" -Check`

Then close and reopen the terminal (and VS Code).

## 4. If something fails

- Run the same command again: finished steps are skipped.
- Look up the error code in [TROUBLESHOOTING.md](TROUBLESHOOTING.md).
- The macOS command stops at once with `curl: (77) error setting certificate verify locations`: a certificate variable points to a file that no longer exists. Run `unset SSL_CERT_FILE CURL_CA_BUNDLE` in the same terminal and paste the command again (code E-NET-09).
- Diagnosis with Claude's help (costs less than US$ 0.01): `bash ~/.workshop-claude/setup-mac.sh --doctor` or `powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$env:USERPROFILE\.workshop-claude\setup-windows.ps1" -Doctor`.
- Send the organizer the file `~/.workshop-claude/summary.txt`. `setup.log` also helps and already comes without secrets.

## Verify before running (optional)

The SHA-256 checksums of every release file are at https://github.com/cx-guilherme-pinto/workshop-claude/releases/download/v1.1.0-rc.4/SHA256SUMS. Release page: https://github.com/cx-guilherme-pinto/workshop-claude/releases/tag/v1.1.0-rc.4.
